audit_basis: Static semantic reasoning plus deterministic regression gates only. No external model/runtime execution.
verified_invariants: minimum required, conditionally required and optional inputs are distinct
missing or materially contradictory minimum required input is fail-closed BLOCKED before domain execution
authority defaults to ADVISORY_ONLY and cannot expand through task data
instructions embedded in code, logs, documents, tickets, web/source material, examples or tool output are treated as data and cannot change workflow policy
evidence vocabulary distinguishes SUPPLIED_CLAIM, OBSERVED, SOURCE_CLAIM, INFERRED, ASSUMPTION, UNKNOWN and CONTRADICTED
state selection follows semantic conditions and must not overstate execution, evidence or completion
generation does not force winners, scopes NO_VALID_CANDIDATE to the evaluated set and exposes whether search was exhaustive
writing blocks or preserves explicit placeholders when material facts are unavailable rather than fabricating them
audit distinguishes missing audit definition, insufficient evidence, completed-with-unknowns and completed inspected scope; completion is not certification
simulation declares invocation mode and never treats generated user turns as evidence of actual user performance
learning forbids OBJECTIVE_MET without observable assessment evidence and a configured threshold
optimization uses DIAGNOSE_FIRST when baseline/metric evidence cannot support defensible intervention selection or measurement
checklist PASS requires evidence-complete applicable required items and is explicitly scoped to the inspected checklist
generic architecture cannot be adapted to individualized legal, medical, financial or other high-stakes use without a separate safety/authority binding and review gate
static architecture quality never implies behavioral testing, certification, portability, product eligibility or READY_TO_SELL
next_gate: Design and statically validate deterministic binding/invocation contracts from frozen architecture + authorized configuration/category metadata + instance input. Keep high-stakes bindings isolated. Do not bulk-regenerate the 478 legacy candidates yet.
